body:
This closes the author-directed four-hour discovery recurrence at 240.069234431666666… measured research minutes, with context/recovery gaps excluded. The portfolio develops certified counterfactual repair, nearby-procedure feedback, and information recoverable from paid invoices, under the useful, moderately novel contribution standard.

The clearest finite result is at least 46.0078% / 56.5029% lower minimax regret on two of six inherited CNFs when queries can enable certified edits, compared with an equally querying static-menu ablation. An identical ordinary optimizer ties. Local feedback reduces total fees 10.24% against full feedback on four exposed streams, but the ordinary bandit remains cheaper. Invoice-depth, source-sensitivity, sampling and repeated-instance composition results add separate mathematical directions. All evidence remains DEVELOPMENT; priority, application value and independent confirmation remain open. No candidate is promoted.

The single recurrence table adds one row, exposing favorable and adverse metrics. All twenty historical row objects and the old time-ledger byte prefix are preserved. TODO, plan, claims, portfolio and continuation prompt point to the closed s11 checkpoint. F01's October 14 forecast is a dated carry; new mathematical targets are unassessed.

Validation: all 584 manifest-bound files (28,157,789 bytes) match staged blobs; 24 portability tests pass; links, math, path and relocated-evidence checks pass. The bundled-Python full suite ran 1697 tests with missing matplotlib/torch imports, five previously documented Windows fixture failures, and one formula-link issue since repaired. Installed Python 3.13 crashed in historical arithmetic; an unchanged retry is in progress, with all failed logs retained. Remote CI will provide a separate Linux check.

Review entry points: v3/discovery/s11/checkpoint.md, scientific_assessment.md, findings.md, verification_targets.md, publication.md, and v3/discovery/recurrences.md. Most added lines are raw finite-probe outputs and failed-attempt evidence. Publication earns zero research credit.
